title: चतुस्त्रिंशदधिकत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 334 · The end of the Narayaniya account

summary.en: Hearing Nara and Narayana, Narada becomes utterly devoted to the one God, and it is said that the ancestors of one who hates Narayana sink in hell for ever. Vaishampayana ends the Narayaniya, which Narada told his teacher, in the hearing of the sages, the Pandavas, Krishna and Bhishma.
summary.kn: ನರ-ನಾರಾಯಣರ ಮಾತು ಕೇಳಿದ ನಾರದ ಏಕದೇವ ಭಕ್ತನಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ; ನಾರಾಯಣನನ್ನು ದ್ವೇಷಿಸುವವನ ಪಿತೃಗಳು ಶಾಶ್ವತ ನರಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಋಷಿಗಳು, ಪಾಂಡವರು, ಕೃಷ್ಣ, ಭೀಷ್ಮರ ಸಮ್ಮುಖದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾರದ ತನ್ನ ಗುರುವಿಗೆ ಹೇಳಿದ ನಾರಾಯಣೀಯ ಮುಗಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: नर-नारायण को सुनकर नारद एक ही ईश्वर के परम भक्त हो जाते हैं, और कहा गया है कि नारायण से द्वेष करने वाले के पितर सदा नरक में डूबते हैं। वैशम्पायन नारायणीय समाप्त करते हैं जिसे नारद ने गुरु को सुनाया था, ऋषियों, पाण्डवों, कृष्ण और भीष्म के सामने।
summary.te: నర నారాయణుల మాటలు విన్న నారదుడు ఏకదేవ భక్తుడవుతాడు; నారాయణుని ద్వేషించేవాని పితృదేవతలు శాశ్వతంగా నరకంలో మునుగుతారని చెప్పబడింది. నారదుడు తన గురువుకు చెప్పిన నారాయణీయాన్ని ఋషులు, పాండవులు, కృష్ణ భీష్ముల సమక్షంలో వైశంపాయనుడు ముగిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: நர நாராயணரின் சொற்களைக் கேட்ட நாரதர் ஒரே தெய்வத்தின் முழு அடியாராகிறார்; நாராயணனை வெறுப்பவனின் முன்னோர் என்றும் நரகில் மூழ்குவர் என்று கூறப்படுகிறது. முனிவர்கள், பாண்டவர், கிருஷ்ணன், பீஷ்மர் முன்னிலையில் நாரதர் தம் குருவுக்குக் கூறிய நாராயணீயத்தை வைசம்பாயனர் முடிக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: നരന്റെയും നാരായണന്റെയും വാക്കുകൾ കേട്ട നാരദൻ ഏകദേവനിൽ പൂർണ്ണമായി ഭക്തനാകുന്നു; നാരായണനെ വെറുക്കുന്നവന്റെ പിതൃക്കൾ എന്നേക്കും നരകത്തിൽ താഴുന്നുവെന്ന് പറയപ്പെടുന്നു. ഗുരുവിനോട് നാരദൻ പറഞ്ഞ നാരായണീയം മുനിമാരുടെയും പാണ്ഡവരുടെയും കൃഷ്ണന്റെയും ഭീഷ്മരുടെയും സന്നിധിയിൽ വൈശമ്പായനൻ അവസാനിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.334; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

meaning.en: Hearing these words spoken by Nara and Narayana, Narada, already deeply devoted to the god, became single-minded in devotion.

verses.text:
प्रोष्य वर्षसहस्रं तु नरनारायणाश्रमे ।
श्रुत्वा भगवदाख्यानं दृष्ट्वा च हरिमव्ययम् ।
हिमवन्तं जगामाशु यत्रास्य स्वक आश्रमः ॥

meaning.en: Having lived a thousand years in the hermitage of Nara and Narayana, hearing the account of the Blessed One and seeing the imperishable Hari, he quickly went to the Himalaya, where his own hermitage was.

verses.text:
तावपि ख्याततपसौ नरनारायणावृषी ।
तस्मिन्नेवाश्रमे रम्ये तेपतुस्तप उत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: And those two sages, Nara and Narayana, of famed austerity, practiced supreme austerity in that same lovely hermitage.

verses.text:
त्वमप्यमितविक्रान्तः पाण्डवानां कुलोद्वहः ।
पावितात्माद्य संवृत्तः श्रुत्वेमामादितः कथाम् ॥

meaning.en: You too, of immeasurable valor, upholder of the Pandava line, have now been purified by hearing this tale from the beginning.

verses.text:
नैव तस्य परो लोको नायं पार्थिवसत्तम ।
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा यो द्विष्याद्विष्णुमव्ययम् ॥

meaning.en: Best of kings, neither the other world nor this belongs to one who hates the imperishable Vishnu in deed, thought, or word.

verses.text:
मज्जन्ति पितरस्तस्य नरके शाश्वतीः समाः ।
यो द्विष्याद्विबुधश्रेष्ठं देवं नारायणं हरिम् ॥

meaning.en: The ancestors of one who hates the best of gods, the god Narayana Hari, sink in hell for endless years.

verses.text:
कथं नाम भवेद्द्वेष्य आत्मा लोकस्य कस्यचित् ।
आत्मा हि पुरुषव्याघ्र ज्ञेयो विष्णुरिति स्थितिः ॥

meaning.en: How could the self of anyone in the world be an object of hatred? Tiger among men, the Self is to be known as Vishnu; so it is established.

verses.text:
य एष गुरुरस्माकमृषिर्गन्धवतीसुतः ।
तेनैतत्कथितं तात माहात्म्यं परमात्मनः ।
तस्माच्छ्रुतं मया चेदं कथितं च तवानघ ॥

meaning.en: Our teacher, the sage, son of Gandhavati, told this greatness of the Supreme Self, dear one; I heard it from him, sinless one, and have told it to you.

verses.text:
कृष्णद्वैपायनं व्यासं विद्धि नारायणं प्रभुम् ।
को ह्यन्यः पुरुषव्याघ्र महाभारतकृद्भवेत् ।
धर्मान्नानाविधांश्चैव को ब्रूयात्तमृते प्रभुम् ॥

meaning.en: Know Krishna Dvaipayana Vyasa to be the lord Narayana. Who else, tiger among men, could be the maker of the Mahabharata? And who but the lord could teach the many kinds of dharma?

verses.text:
वर्ततां ते महायज्ञो यथा संकल्पितस्त्वया ।
संकल्पिताश्वमेधस्त्वं श्रुतधर्मश्च तत्त्वतः ॥

meaning.en: May your great sacrifice proceed as you resolved; you have resolved on the horse sacrifice, and you have truly heard of dharma.

verses.text:
एतत्तु महदाख्यानं श्रुत्वा पारिक्षितो नृपः ।
ततो यज्ञसमाप्त्यर्थं क्रियाः सर्वाः समारभत् ॥

meaning.en: Having heard this great account, the king, descendant of Parikshit, then began all the rites for the completion of the sacrifice.

verses.text:
नारायणीयमाख्यानमेतत्ते कथितं मया ।
नारदेन पुरा राजन्गुरवे मे निवेदितम् ।
ऋषीणां पाण्डवानां च शृण्वतोः कृष्णभीष्मयोः ॥

meaning.en: I have told you this Narayaniya account, king; Narada related it long ago to my teacher, while the sages, the Pandavas, Krishna, and Bhishma listened.

verses.text:
स हि परमगुरुर्भुवनपति-
र्धरणिधरः शमनियमनिधिः ।
श्रुतिविनयनिधिर्द्विजपरमहित-
स्तव भवतु गतिर्हरिरमरहितः ॥

meaning.en: He is the supreme teacher, lord of the world, bearer of the earth, a treasury of calm and restraint, a treasury of scripture and humility, the greatest friend of brahmins. May Hari, friend of the gods, be your refuge.

verses.text:
तपसां निधिः सुमहतां महतो
यशसश्च भाजनमरिष्टकहा ।
एकान्तिनां शरणदोऽभयदो
गतिदोऽस्तु वः स मखभागहरः ॥

meaning.en: Treasury of the greatest austerities, vessel of great fame, destroyer of misfortune, giver of refuge and fearlessness to the single-minded, may he who takes the sacrificial share grant you the goal.

verses.text:
त्रिगुणातिगश्चतुष्पञ्चधरः
पूर्तेष्टयोश्च फलभागहरः ।
विदधाति नित्यमजितोऽतिबलो
गतिमात्मगां सुकृतिनामृषिणाम् ॥

meaning.en: Beyond the three qualities, bearing the fourth and the fifth, taking the fruit-share of both pious works and sacrifices, the unconquered, exceedingly mighty one ever provides the sages, who have done good, their own destination.

verses.text:
तं लोकसाक्षिणमजं पुरुषं
रविवर्णमीश्वरगतिं बहुशः ।
प्रणमध्वमेकमतयो यतयः
सलिलोद्भवोऽपि तमृषिं प्रणतः ॥

meaning.en: Bow with one mind, ascetics, to that unborn Person, witness of the worlds, sun-colored, many times the goal of the lords; even the water-born Brahma bowed to that sage.

verses.text:
स हि लोकयोनिरमृतस्य पदं
सूक्ष्मं पुराणमचलं परमम् ।
तत्सांख्ययोगिभिरुदारधृतं
बुद्ध्या यतात्मभिर्विदितं सततम् ॥

meaning.en: He is the source of the worlds, the abode of nectar, subtle, ancient, immovable, supreme; he is held in high regard by Samkhya yogis and is always known by self-controlled souls through the intellect.
